description: Land Acquisition - Borella, Thimbirigasyaya D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for acquiring specific land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their boundaries, assessment numbers, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
